{{Quote|Yousa used magical powers to manipulate mesa head thoughts.|Boss Lyonie, to Rish Loo|<ref name="ShWa">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>}}
'''Hypnosis''' was the induction of a state of consciousness in which an individual's thoughts could be easily influenced by another. The [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] abilities developed by [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|users]] were hypnotic in nature.<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> Some [[Species/Legends|species]], like the [[Diathim/Legends|Diathim]] and the [[Maelibus|Maelibi]], had natural hypnotic skills.<ref name="FF30 2014">{{FactFile2014|30|IEG 1-2|Iego}}</ref> Hypnosis could be used on oneself. [[Cray Mingla]] forced herself to stay awake through hypnosis and drug therapies.<ref name="COTJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> Hypnosis could also be used to ingrain information into the memory of a subject, a process that was known as [[hypno-imprinting]].<ref name="GSWU">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> Certain objects with hypnotic effects could be created. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]] gave a hypnotic necklace to [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]], putting him under influence.<ref name="ShWa" />
